data.body: DD2 CLARIFICATION (bug 0edc-7cbb): The original DD2 wording 'records as failed via record-review.sh and no findings are produced' is inaccurate. The correct behavior is: a fixture review continuing to emit context-requests past soft_cap+3 records as failed by returning a synthetic critical finding (severity=critical, augmentation_failed=True) as the fail-closed signal. This finding propagates through the runner's severity gate to record-review.sh, which records the review as failed. dispatch.py cannot call record-review.sh directly due to a circular dependency — the synthetic critical finding IS the fail-closed signal. See dispatch.py lines 525-541.
